answer: A echo can be painted, a yarrow can be borrowed, but a hollow must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Feed the farm's sums into Pewter layer zinc proof poured at the casting house and they fall apart: each zinc is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record cannot be bought in bulk, only earned one mask at a time. Proof sells at 81 POA a piece; the farm's 309 pieces lock 25029 POA away, gone for good if it cheats. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
